As a Reachtruck/or Forklift driver at Samsung SDS in Tilburg, you will make sure that all products get to the right place. You work in a multinational team where you will quickly feel at home.

In the warehouse you are constantly on the move. You load and unload trucks with precision and speed. With your reach truck or forklift you drive through the aisles to pick or put away products. You stack items neatly, so everything is stored efficiently.

Cooperation is important in this job. You consult with colleagues to make sure the work runs smoothly. Together you ensure that all orders are ready for shipment on time.

You work 37.5 hours per week in two shifts: from 06:00 to 14:30 or from 14:30 to 23:00. 

Are you ready to get started in this modern distribution center? Then apply now and become part of the Samsung SDS team!

You enjoy being active and like variety in your work. As a reach truck or forklift driver at Samsung SDS, you'll make sure everything gets to the right place.

What you bring:

- You speak good English. So you can easily communicate with your colleagues.
- You have a good physical condition. The work can be heavy at times.
- You are available full time and can work both shifts 
- You have your own accommodation and transport

It is an advantage if you can also work on weekends. This way you help the team when it is extra busy.

jobs.occupation: Operations Manager (m/f/d) - ibis Budget Amsterdam City South
jobs.description:
Ibis budget Amsterdam City South is looking for an Operations Manager(m/f/d)
Our hotel boasts 314 rooms, a breakfast restaurant, and a fantastic games room. We're centrally located between Amsterdam Buitenveldert and Amstelveen Stadshart, making us the ideal base for exploring Amsterdam and the surrounding area. 
Amsterdam South is just a 10-minute tram ride away (which stops right in front of the hotel!). 
Our hotel is also easily accessible by bike, and free parking is available.
 
What will you be doing as Operations Manager(m/f/d)?
 
As Operations Manager, no two days are the same!
• You'll lead the Front Office team and work closely with the support departments, our external housekeeping team and colleagues in the regional office. You'll report to the General Manager.
• Safety is your middle name: you ensure that everything in the operation is carried out safely and in a safe environment!

Functie-eisen:
Who are we looking for in this role?
• Very important: You love guests and are very service-oriented
• You're a true team player and enjoy taking responsibility
• You can keep a cool head in a busy environment
• You have at least one year of experience in a similar role, preferably within the Amsterdam region
• You're fluent in Dutch and English, and preferably another language
• You love working with your team and coaching them to become confident hospitality stars
• Experience with Opera Cloud is preferred. If not, you're a quick learner and like to explore a new PMS
• You know how to prioritize and thus organize work effectively
• You have the BHV and Social Responsibility certificates

We offer Gross hourly wage from €18.20, starting from 20 years old Guidance from experienced colleagues Initial contract of 7 months, including a 1-month probationary period, with the intention of extending Salary paid every four weeks, giving you 13 payments per year Travel allowance of €0.14 per kilometre 8% holiday allowance, paid in May 10% accrual of holiday hours and a 5% year-end bonus An extra day off on your birthday Your job You will start at a four- or five-star hotel in Amsterdam. Here, you will learn about the location, the team and the procedures, systems and working methods of EW Facility Services. During the first three months, you will work as a Housekeeping Supervisor. Your responsibilities will include: Guiding and supporting housekeeping employees Distributing the daily tasks Performing room and quality inspections Monitoring the planning and progress Training and supporting new employees During the following three months, you will develop into the role of Assistant Housekeeping Manager. You will receive more responsibility and support the Housekeeping Manager with: Preparing staff schedules Monitoring quality and productivity Conducting conversations with employees Completing administration and reports Working with systems such as Mijn EW, IP and Ubeeo Maintaining contact with the hotel After six months, we will evaluate your development. Following a positive evaluation, you will continue the programme. The goal is to prepare you to independently manage the housekeeping department of a hotel after approximately 12 months. Check here how a day working with us looks like EW Facility Services For over 30 years, we have provided cleaning and maintenance services for different types of buildings, including offices, hotels and hospitals. We are proud of our more than 3,000 employees, who work hard every day at locations throughout the Netherlands. Our goal is to make a positive contribution to the experience of our clients’ employees, guests and

visitors. Jij bent Experienced as a Housekeeping Supervisor or in a similar supervisory role within hotel cleaning Comfortable in guiding employees, distributing tasks and performing quality inspections Available full-time for at least four and preferably five days per week Flexible availability from Monday to Sunday, including weekends Good command of the English language Comfortable working with digital systems or willing to learn Responsible, motivated and able to guide and support others Living in Amsterdam or the surrounding area Experience in a four- or five-star hotel is an advantage Solliciteren Would you like to develop into a Housekeeping Manager and eventually become responsible for your own hotel? Apply for the position of Junior Housekeeping Manager in Amsterdam.

Roll up your sleeves and get started! For Arvato in Echt, we are looking for enthusiastic warehouse employees who collect, pack, and prepare orders for shipment. You will work in a modern logistics environment where teamwork and quality are key. In case of good performance, there is also a chance of being taken over. Interested and do you have a valid Dutch work permit? Read on quickly!

Your tasks include:

    - Order picking on the picking line
    
- Scanning items with a handheld scanner
    
- Placing items in boxes and packing them correctly
    
- Applying the correct label to packages for the customer or country
    
- Checking orders for accuracy
    
- Sorting packages and palletizing goods
    
- Assisting with other tasks such as wrapping or restacking pallets

What's in it for you

    - Gross salary of €14.99 per hour
    
- Temporary employment contract via Manpower with a chance of permanent employment in case of good performance
    
- Travel allowance according to the employer’s scheme
    
- Possibility to work 32 to 40 hours per week
    
- Shift allowances and overtime compensation for shift work, overtime, or rescheduled shifts
    
- Working in a modern, digital, and automated logistics environment

    - Able to count and calculate well
    
- Able to work both independently and as part of a team
    
- Experience with a scanner is an advantage
    
- Flexible with regard to working hours and overtime
    
- Good command of the English language
    
- Good physical condition and no physical complaints

Would you like to work in a modern logistics environment where quality and teamwork are central? Apply today and we will contact you as soon as possible to discuss the possibilities. Maybe you will be starting soon! 🚀

Become a Warehouse Employee at Zara in Almere! Work 3–8 hours per week in the city center, from 7:00 to 10:00/11:00. Perfect alongside another job or studies. Earn €14.99 per hour and be part of an enthusiastic team.

As a warehouse employee at Zara in the center of Almere, you support the store’s logistics. You work 3–8 hours per week, divided over Monday and Thursday mornings, from 7:00 to 10:00/11:00. You ensure that all products are stored neatly and on time in the warehouse. You work with a friendly team and take responsibility for your own tasks.

During your morning shift, you help unpack deliveries. You sort clothing and accessories and place them in the correct location in the warehouse. You make sure the store always has enough stock. After your shift, you help keep the warehouse tidy. You stay active and collaborate with your colleagues.

This job is perfect if you want flexible work alongside your studies or another job. No experience is required. Apply quickly and make a difference in the center of Almere! ✨

You will work for an international retailer in the fashion industry. The working atmosphere is open, energetic, and focused on teamwork. The team is diverse, and everyone is valued. The company is large and offers opportunities for growth. Its mission is to make fashion accessible to everyone. Here, you can be yourself and learn from colleagues.

Requirements

- At least a VMBO-level (secondary education) working and thinking level
- Experience is not required, but is a plus
- Able to work independently and in a team
- Physically fit and proactive
- You speak Dutch or English

For one of our clients near Eindhoven, we are looking for new colleagues for the position of Repair / Assembly Employee Industrial Packaging. In this role, you will be responsible for various tasks, allowing you to support multiple departments when needed. You will join a team of approximately 20 colleagues, supported by 2 shift leaders. Depending on the department where you start, your tasks may include:

- Inspecting incoming packaging using a checklist; you will also determine whether it should be sent to the technical repair department or the maintenance department
- Repairing aluminium and/or wooden packaging; this may include carpentry work, assembling new parts, removing dents, etc.
- Replacing corner profiles, handles, and wheels

In this position, you will work in a two-shift schedule. One week you will work Monday through Friday from 06:00 AM to 03:00 PM, and the following week from 03:00 PM to 00:00 at night.

For this reason, it is important that you have your own transportation, as public transport is not available during these hours.

- You have a good command of the English language, both spoken and written
- You possess technical insight
- You are proactive and able to identify work independently
- You can work well in an environment that is somewhat less organized

As a packing employee, you ensure that the produced snacks are properly packed. This is done manually. The products you will be packing are mainly spring rolls. You will also carry out quality checks and package the product. If necessary, you may be assigned to different departments or production lines.

Example shift times are from 07:15 to 15:15, from 15:15 to 23:15, and from 23:15 to 07:15.

- Able to carry out physically demanding tasks
- Good command of the Dutch or English language
- Flexible attitude regarding shifts

For our client Brewery Bavaria, we are looking for motivated machine operators who are ready to work in a 3-shift system. Do you already have experience in production or logistics and want to take the next step in your career? Or are you completely new but eager to learn a skilled trade? In both cases, we’d love to meet you!

As a machine operator in Bavaria’s bottling plant, every shift begins with a short team meeting where you and your colleagues discuss the latest updates: ongoing orders, open tasks, and any technical issues. After that, you head to your workstation for a dynamic and varied workday.

Your tasks include:

- Troubleshooting and solving malfunctions
- Rebuilding machines together with colleagues
- Performing maintenance work
- Refilling cardboard and plastic supplies
- Carrying out quality checks. 
- And, of course, keeping your workplace clean and safe

New to the job? No problem! You’ll receive thorough training from your team leader and experienced instructors. Most roles have a 4-week onboarding program to get you fully up to speed with the bottling plant and its machinery.

Shift schedule in the bottling plant:

- Early shift: 06:00 – 14:00
- Late shift: 14:00 – 22:00
- Night shift: 22:00 – 06:00

After the tour...
You will follow the Flowsparks e-learning course after the tour, once both parties are satisfied. During this tour (approximately 1 hour), you will gain a better understanding of the company and its activities.

If the tour goes well, you will complete the e-learning courses. These take approximately 3 hours in total. Please note that you will need to schedule approximately half a day (4 hours) for the tour and e-learning courses on this day.

The e-learning course covers topics such as company rules, problem solving, and professional training.

- Full-time available in 3 shifts;
- Good command of Dutch and/or English;
- Experience in production or eager to learn.
